# Tano Core 0.9.2

Opening the built-in settings tab previously made native session validation reject
the recovery record. This release accepts the settings-tab identity and preserves
the active tab, pane layout, unsaved document draft and draft baseline together.
Unknown tab identities remain rejected.

The five npm packages and the tano-native crate share version 0.9.2 and the same
source commit. Registry publication and platform acceptance are pending until
their corresponding evidence is complete.
